name: Goodlyfe | 1g Infused Pre-Roll | Lemon Drop
description: Lemon Drop is a sativa dominant hybrid similar to the sugar coated, lemon-flavored treat. This strain is a perfect refresher with tart lemon and citrus flavor. Lemon Drop will provide you with a boost of energy and focus, while also helping relieve pain. Its dominant terpenes are Limonene and a-Terpineol.
